rover.label: PLACEHOLDER
rover.note: The rover is a mobile comms relay and the crew's shelter: it parks at a relay site for each transect and moves only during the last station of a transect (or the first leg); the walk ends at the rover.

storm.label: MODELED
storm.note: Relative dose in open-sky minutes over the event: the exposed walk (S along the fastest path) plus the rest of the event at the refuge's S. Refuges: the rover where it is parked (S PLACEHOLDER), the nearest terrain shielding zone (its own S), or staying put; the lowest dose wins. While the rover drives, the higher dose of its two parking places is shown.

walker_model.label: MODELED with PLACEHOLDER suit settings
walker_model.note: Minetti et al. 2002 cost of walking with a PLACEHOLDER suit and gravity factor; Mars gravity is outside NASA/TP-2010-216125's tested range.
